Average bike rentals by hour for a selected day type

summarise_hourly.Rd

Average bike rentals by hour for a selected day type

Usage

summarise_hourly(data, day_type)

Arguments

data

A data frame with hour, day_type, casual and registered columns, such as bike_hourly.

day_type

Either "Working day" or "Non-working day".

Value

A data frame with one row per observed hour. The casual and registered columns give mean rentals across recorded days of that type.

Examples

summarise_hourly(bike_hourly, "Working day")
